_help: Manually override which candidates are featured for a seat, e.g. when money alone misidentifies the real top-tier field. Key = seat code (AZ-01, TX-senate). Value = list of name fragments as in FEC data. FEC-flagged incumbents are always shown regardless. Once real nominees are known, use nominees.json instead - it takes priority over this file.
_note: Served from data/ because Vercel treats /api as serverless functions and will not serve .json files there. api/featured.json is kept in sync as the editable source of record.
